candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to after picking or creating a pet so users form an emotional attachment before signing in.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right away, and 8 support tickets report pet loss after signing in again.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in step after adoption selection within onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Moving sign-in after value creation directly addresses the 27.1% sign-in drop and 8 support tickets.

candidates.title: Live Desktop Pet Preview & Creation Studio
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload step into a two-column live preview studio with photo quality tips and pet rendering feedback.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops 39.1% of users with high mean time (1017s), and 3 support emails reported failed or strange custom pets.

upload_photos.headline: Design Your Custom Desktop Companion
upload_photos.body: Upload clear, well-lit photos for accurate 3D desktop pet rendering.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen into a live preview studio maintains its core functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest drop step (39.1%) and reported pet creation bugs, but requires a full studio redesign.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough
candidates.change: Add a dedicated controls walkthrough screen explaining how to summon, move, talk to, and hide the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple complaints from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

new_pet_controls.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
new_pet_controls.body: Learn desktop hotkeys, summoning, hiding, and talking to your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a new controls walkthrough screen within onboarding is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Helps clarify pet controls for confused users, though adding a new screen increases finish step friction.

candidates.why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing heavy user drop-off right before completion.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Getting Ready!
waiting.body: Play with desktop toys while your companion finishes waking up.

components.text: Click toys to play while pet renders in the background

candidates.why: The single largest support complaint (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing back in.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' suggests skipping a step

candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%, requiring stronger initial visual pull on screen 1.

story.headline: Your Desktop Companion Awaits
story.body: Meet an AI virtual pet that lives, plays, and keeps you company right on your computer screen.

guard.reason: Adding an animated mascot preview to the story screen retains its primary function of introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: Initial intro screen already converts relatively well (76.2%); animated copy provides minor value pull.

picked: Live Desktop Pet Preview & Creation Studio

decisions.title: Live Desktop Pet Preview & Creation Studio

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding by moving sign-in after adoption selection was effective (+12.0%) and accurately predicted.
Redesigning adoption selection (live pet preview) showed no clear effect, with predictions (+8.0%) being too high.
Adding desktop visibility diagnostics and alerts (notifications) showed no clear effect, overestimating impact (+5.0% predicted).
Animated mascot app intro changes (copy/choose_path) showed no clear effect, and predictions (+3.0%) were too high.
